Friend or Foe?: The Proteasome as a Target for Combined Cancer Therapy
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the proteasome is not only an essential component in the execution of apoptosis but also plays a critical role in the regulation of the apoptotic machinery.

proteasome inhibitors should not be used in combination with other apoptosis inducers unless the underlying mechanism of action has been thoroughly investigated and the proteasome has been proven not to play an essential role for the apoptosis pathway.
a combination of proteasomal inhibitors and other apoptosis-inducing agents should not be considered as a universal strategy for the treatment of tumors.

the use of proteasome inhibitors in combination therapies requires a thorough analysis of the underlying mechanism of action of the applied agents in order to achieve the desired effect.
